summary: Dedicated and self‑motivated professional with experience in providing outstanding support to business partners. Skillful in tracking details, office management, and following‑up with internal and external partners to ensure on‑time completion of projects. Possesses easily transferable skills such as organization, working with teams, time keeping/payroll and business writing.

experience.title: HR Employee Relations Specialist
responsibilities: Conducted investigations and resolutions of workplace issues/inquiries from field employees and management.
Served as a partner for managers and employees by ensuring application of company policies and procedures.
Created and conducted training for hourly and salaried employees.
Supported performance management process for all employees.
Partnered with Equifax and Unemployment Cost Control to research and respond to unemployment claims.

experience.title: Store Operations Associate
responsibilities: Monitored inventory control, processed physical counts of all merchandise, organized and secured all inventory.
Assisted with floor sets, created service desk tickets for defective equipment.
Processed customer trade‑ins and returns of cellular devices and accessories.
Provided general customer service and processed account payments.

experience.title: Clerical/Staff Associate IV
responsibilities: Verified and updated business caption listings in Common Suite System.
Reviewed Directory Listing Reports to confirm data accuracy.
Corrected discrepancies between written order requests and database system.
Input payroll and provided payroll administrative support.
Executed directory specific reports for final printing and shipping.
Conducted training sessions for new hires on writing service orders.
Created learning materials including policy & procedure manuals.
